data.name: Ilaahun
data.gender_notes: Ilaahun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is in control of all things, the Sustainer, the Provider, the Almighty. The name Ilaahun carries the meaning “God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ilaahun usually hope their child will grow to embody god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ilaahun signifies the belief in one Allah, the creator and sustainer of the universe. It is a name of God in Islam, and a reminder of His divine power and mercy.
data.etymology: Ilaahun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ilaahun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: إلهون
in_arabic.meaning: إلهون تعالي الله، إله واحد الأحد
in_arabic.long_meaning: إلهون هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة إله، و يعني الله الواحد الأحد، الإله الذي لا شريك له، اسم يدل على توحيد الله تعالى و عظمته. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: الہون
in_urdu.long_meaning: الہون ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ واحد احد، وہ اللہ جو کسی کا شریک نہیں ہے، یہ نام اللہ تعالی کی وحدانیت اور عظمت کی دلالت کرتا ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں کئی بار ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ اسلامی ثقافت میں گہری معانیを持つ ناموں میں سے ایک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इलाहुन
in_hindi.long_meaning: इलाहुन एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है परमेश्वर, अद्वितीय ईश्वर, वह ईश्वर जो किसी का साथी नहीं है, यह नाम ईश्वर की अद्वैत और महिमा की ओर संकेत करता है। यह नाम कुरआन में कई बार आया है और इस्लामी संस्कृति में गहरे अर्थों वाला नाम है।

in_pashto.name: الاهون
in_pashto.long_meaning: الاهون د ښځینه يوه نوم دی، چي د عربي ټکي څخه اخيستل شوی دی، مانا يې دے الله واحد بې شريک، هغه الله چي کوم شريک نلري، دا نوم د الله تعالی د يواليت او عظمت په مانا دلالت کوي. دا نوم په قرآن کريم کي څو ځله راغلی دی، او دا داسلامي کلتور په منځ کي د يو مهم نوم څخه شميرل کيږي.

in_english.name: Ilaahun
in_english.meaning: Ilaahun means God, One and Only
in_english.long_meaning: Ilaahun is a feminine given name derived from Arabic roots, meaning God, the One and Only, the deity without a partner. The name signifies the unity and majesty of God. It appears several times in the Quran and holds deep significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the oneness of God and the rejection of polytheism. The name reflects spiritual devotion and monotheism.

It's an expression of faith and devotion to Allah, emphasizing the centrality of God in Muslim culture and daily life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Ilaahun" is a constant reminder of Allah's power, authority, and endless mercy. It's a powerful name that evokes a sense of deep reverence and awe towards Allah. It's a name that inspires one to submit completely to Allah's will and seek His guidance in all aspects of life. In Islamic tradition, the name "Ilaahun" is used to remember and affirm the oneness of God and to recognize and appreciate Allah's presence in all things.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "God" symbolizes One who is in control of all things, the Sustainer, the Provider, the Almighty. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ilaahun serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of god.
